tasks.name: shipment-tracking-pipeline
tasks.prompt: 查询国际订单（query 用 international），取前 12 个。对每个订单，用订单号作为 order_no、目的国作为 country 获取物流跟踪。只保留状态为 active 且预计到达天数不超过 7 天的订单，按预计到达天数从短到长取前 3 个，返回订单号。

arguments.source:
orders = shipment.search_orders(query="international", limit=12)
tracking = map(orders, shipment.get_tracking(order_no=_.order_id, country=_.country))
active_orders = filter(tracking, status="active")
quick = select(active_orders, "eta_days <= 7")
ranked = sort(quick, key="eta_days")
top = take(ranked, 3)
ids = top.order_id
return ids
